title: Owner: keep the 44-point onboarding toggle and Skip and accept their sweep findings
context: Wave 2 Lane 5 (onboarding-a11y) reports 28 sweep lines: 17 for the phone light/dark toggle (44x44) and 11 for Skip (52x44). Both meet spec 16.40, but the sweep's small-target rule is 48. Lane 5 left them unrecorded, so onboarding_sweep 'matches the baseline' fails. This is the same conflict as the header gear (decision 01M3ZXYD3M8K0R94MH5CDX1M80).
options: Keep 44 and accept them in fixes_recorded or the onboarding baseline policy
Enlarge the tap areas to 48 with the visuals unchanged
outcome: The owner chose "Keep 44, accept it". In the onboarding fix-up, accept small-target lines for the phone toggle and Skip on the onboarding phone states only, by their labels and the onboarding area, then record them in test/accessibility/baselines/onboarding.txt. Also update the notifications-off test to the current findings: none for the sidebar, and the toggle line for the bottom bar.
